title: Employer Handbook: Inactive, Reactivated and Closed Tax Accounts
content:
## Inactivation

An active account in the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts is inactivated when its consecutive zero-wage quarters reach the inactivation quarters, or at once when the employer reports that it temporarily has no employees. The consecutive zero-wage quarters are the consecutive most recent quarters, up to the latest quarter whose due date has passed, whose latest report shows total wages of zero. An inactive account files no reports.

## Reactivation

Wages resuming within the reactivation window reactivate the same account with its rate and reserve; after the window the employer must register again.

## Closure

Closing the account is the employer's own decision: the representative records the closure request, and the account closes once the employer confirms it. An account is closed only when its final report has been filed and its balance due is zero. Both facts are read from the Department's records for that account: a final report on file for the account, and the account's balance due.

Closure does not end liability for quarters already worked, and a successor that acquires the business is handled under the rules on transfer of experience.

## Account statuses in this setting

| From | To | How |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Inactive | No wages for the inactivation quarters, or the employer reports it temporarily has no employees |
| Inactive | Active | Wages resume within the reactivation window |
| Registered | Closed | The employer confirms it never became liable and asks to close the registration |
| Active | Closed | The employer confirms the business ended, after its final report and a zero balance |
| Inactive | Closed | The employer confirms the business ended while inactive, with a zero balance |

## Closure conditions in combination

| Final report filed | Balance due is zero | Account may close |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes, once the employer confirms |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

**Hypothetical case.** An employer that ended its business files its final report, and its balance due stands at USD 0.00. The closure request is recorded; the account closes once the employer confirms it. Its liability for the quarters it already worked does not end with the closure.
